findings.title: Model Router Call Log Missing

evidence.observation: Model router is active but call_log_exists is false at configured path /opt/starship-endeavour/core/model-router/call_log.jsonl

proposed_action.description: Ensure the directory exists and the model router service has write permissions to record call logs.

findings.expected_benefit: Restores audit logging and telemetry for model routing latency and failures.

findings.title: Phase 5 Research Command Placeholder Code

evidence.observation: Unimplemented Phase 5 authorization checking and integration stubs marked with TODO comments

proposed_action.description: Implement Phase 5 Supabase authorization checks and memory integration or track via backlog issues.

findings.expected_benefit: Completes planned security and integration features for the research command.

findings.title: Direct LLM API Key Fallback Bypassing Model Router

evidence.observation: Direct invocation of call_gemini and call_mistral reading raw environment keys GEMINI_API_KEY and MISTRAL_API_KEY instead of routing through model router

proposed_action.description: Refactor emergency alert synthesis calls to route through the centralized model router port 8891.

findings.expected_benefit: Enforces unified model routing, quota management, and fallback telemetry.
